items.quote: Then said the LORD unto Moses
Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you
items.claim: The LORD promised to cause bread to fall from heaven for the people

items.quote: and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day
items.claim: The people will go out daily to gather a measured amount of bread

items.quote: that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no
items.claim: God's stated purpose is to test whether the people will obey his law
items.mechanism: the daily provision and gathering requirement
